ck_offers_fuel_type.name: ck_offers_fuel_type
ck_offers_fuel_type.value: fuel_type IS NULL OR fuel_type IN ('petrol', 'diesel', 'hybrid', 'plugin_hybrid', 'electric', 'lpg', 'other')

ck_offers_transmission.name: ck_offers_transmission
ck_offers_transmission.value: transmission IS NULL OR transmission IN ('manual', 'automatic', 'other')

ck_offers_ratings.name: ck_offers_ratings
ck_offers_ratings.value: (equipment_rating IS NULL OR equipment_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND (apparent_condition_rating IS NULL OR apparent_condition_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)
